enrichment.sourceIssueCandidate: The item title says 2026-2027, but the action text calls the agreement a "Services Agreement 2025-2026" while giving a term of August 3, 2026 through June 30, 2027.
enrichment.summary: Oakland Symphony will teach music classes during the after-school program at Hoover, Garfield, Manzanita SEED, Brookfield and Martin Luther King, Jr. Elementary Schools, two days a week for 30 weeks, for up to 160 students and at least 432 hours. The amount is not to exceed $60,000.00 for August 3, 2026 through June 30, 2027. The work was scheduled to start before the Board's approval.

history.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report
history.motion: A motion was made by Director Latta, seconded by Director Thompson, to Approve the General Consent Report. The motion carried by the following vote

notes.text: The action text labels the agreement "2025-2026" while the title says 2026-2027, but the explicit dates in the text (August 3, 2026 through June 30, 2027) govern the term.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.text: Ratification by the Board of Education of a Services Agreement 2025-2026 by and between the District and Oakland Symphony, Oakland CA, for the latter to provide high-quality music instruction classes during the after-school program at Hoover Elementary School, Garfield Elementary School, Manzanita SEED Elementary School, Brookfield Elementary School and Martin Luther King, Jr. Elementary School campuses, two (2) days a week, 90 minutes per class, for thirty (30) weeks, for up to 160 students for a minimum of 432 hours of service, via the Community Schools and Student Services Department, for the period of August 3, 2026 through June 30, 2027, in an amount not to exceed $60,000.00.
items.title: Services Agreement 2026-2027 - Oakland Symphony - Community Schools and Student Services Department
